يعتبرون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَبِرُونَ (yaʕtabirūna) /jaʕ.ta.bi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# يُعْتَبَرُونَ (yuʕtabarūna) /juʕ.ta.ba.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
